source.title: The Effect of Berberine on Metabolic Profiles in Type 2 Diabetic Patients: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
source.source_type: systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials

source_integrity_notes: The abstract and forest plots report HbA1c MD -0.73, FPG MD -0.86, and 2hPG MD -1.26, while the Results narrative reports -0.75, -0.89, and -1.31, respectively. Both versions are preserved.
The serum creatinine and BUN Results narrative values do not match Figure 10(a) and Figure 10(b). Both versions are preserved.
The BUN Results narrative prints SMD -0.29, 95% CI -0.69 to -0.11, with P=0.16. The confidence interval excludes zero but the printed P value is not significant.
The gastrointestinal adverse-event Results narrative prints RR 0.81 with 95% CI 0.46 to 1.14, while Figure 10(d) prints 0.46 to 1.41.

Supplementary File 2 contains several subgroup rows in which the printed P value conflicts with a confidence interval that crosses zero, and one row where the point estimate lies outside its printed confidence interval. No value was repaired.

schema_gaps: The LiteratureAtom schema has no dedicated systematic-review, meta-analysis, GRADE-certainty, heterogeneity, or risk-of-bias fields. These are preserved in atom kinds, tags, canonical statements, source anchors, and original_result_text without schema redesign.
extraction_limitations: The source is secondary literature. Underlying randomized trial results require direct extraction from the cited primary publications before use as primary-study atoms.
Forest plots contain many study-level rows. This run atomized pooled review-level estimates and prespecified subgroup results rather than every study row.
The article and supplements contain internal numeric inconsistencies. They were preserved and flagged, not silently corrected.
No external current-practice verification was performed because @VERIFY was not activated.
